name: com.getcontractalerts/tender-alerts
title: Get Contract Alerts
description: UK and EU public tender search and alerts: Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, TED and national portals

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Search open government contracts, public sector tenders and public procurement opportunities in the UK and Europe (not US or other non-European contracts). Returns titles, buyers, countries, values, deadlines and the official notice link. By default only notices closing at least 3 days from now (or with no stated deadline, labelled "deadline_unknown"). English queries also match foreign-language notices through CPV procurement categories.

query.description: The work being bought, in a few words, e.g. "website development" or "school cleaning".

countries.description: Countries to search, by English name or ISO code (e.g. ["DE", "France", "GB"]). Omit to search every covered country.

region.description: "eu" for the 27 EU member states only, "uk" for the United Kingdom, "europe_non_eu" for other European countries, "all" (default) for everything covered. Combined with countries, only countries inside the region are searched.

cpv_codes.description: Optional CPV codes or prefixes to require, e.g. ["72", "90910000"].

min_value.description: Minimum stated value. Needs currency; values are never converted, and notices without a stated value are excluded.

currency.description: Three-letter currency for min_value, e.g. EUR, GBP.

include_unknown_deadline.description: Include notices with no stated deadline (default true).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same search.

tools.name: find_matching_tenders
tools.description: Find open public sector tenders and government contracts in the UK and Europe that may suit a particular business, from a short description of what it does or its public website. Each result says which words or procurement categories matched. A match is not a judgement of eligibility.

business_description.description: What the business does, e.g. "We clean offices and schools in Dublin and Kildare." Preferred over business_website.

business_website.description: Public website of the business, used only when no description is given, e.g. example.com.

countries.description: Countries to search, by English name or ISO code (e.g. ["DE", "France", "GB"]). Omit to search every covered country.

region.description: "eu" for the 27 EU member states only, "uk" for the United Kingdom, "europe_non_eu" for other European countries, "all" (default) for everything covered. Combined with countries, only countries inside the region are searched.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same search.

tools.name: get_tender_details
tools.description: Full stored details of one public tender: description, buyer, value, deadline, CPV codes, conditions quoted from the notice where available, and the official notice link.

tools.name: get_market_coverage
tools.description: Which European countries and public procurement sources are searchable, how many open notices each currently has, and when the data was last updated.

tools.name: start_tender_alerts
tools.description: Request Monday-to-Friday email alerts of new public tenders for a business: each night Get Contract Alerts checks newly published tenders in the chosen European countries and emails the ones that fit the business the next weekday morning, once each. Signup is free: no card details or payment are taken, and alerts stop after the seven-day free trial unless the subscriber chooses to pay. The reply states the exact terms. Nothing is sent until the owner of the email address clicks the confirmation link. Supported countries: Albania, Andorra, Austria, Belgium, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Moldova, Monaco, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, San Marino, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Türkiye, Ukraine, United Kingdom. "All countries" selects every one.

email.description: Email address that will receive the alerts.

business_description.description: One to three sentences in the user's words about what the business does and where it works, e.g. "We clean offices and schools in Dublin and Kildare."

countries.description: Countries where the user wants public contracts, by English name (e.g. "Ireland", "United Kingdom"), or ["All countries"].

tools.name: list_supported_countries
tools.description: List the European countries Get Contract Alerts covers, with a page for each describing its public tender sources.
